Are you in NY for the Climate Week? 🏙️ 

Join us at UNDP sessions during the SDG7 Action Forum for a series of dynamic side events, and learn about: 

☀️ Decentralized energy systems driving sustainable development in rural areas  
🌍 Unlocking private capital for renewable energy in Africa  
💡 Approaches to expanding access to clean cooking technologies 
🌱 Evidence-based insights on how clean cooking impacts agrifood systems, climate mitigation, and environmental restoration 

Join us! We need everyone—across regions, sectors, and borders—to be part of this conversation. By fostering collaboration, sharing knowledge, and aligning interests, we can create a more robust and inclusive energy governance ecosystem.  

The sessions will be available online for remote participation. Stay tuned for more details on how to join virtually. 💻 

Explore the full #SDG7 Action Forum agenda here 👉 un.org/en/energy
